Role
Who you are
Possesses a proven track record of ownership, having successfully managed complex technical systems end-to-end while maintaining high reliability and performance standards
Demonstrates technical mastery of modern infrastructure and AI integration, with the ability to lead technical design reviews and influence the broader engineering organization's technical direction
Exhibits a systematic approach to analysis, breaking down complex productivity blockers into root causes and designing scalable, AI-driven solutions to address them
Navigates stakeholder relations with precision, effectively communicating technical trade-offs to non-technical partners and resolving cross-team dependencies to maintain high execution speed
Prioritizes efficiency and ROI, consistently translating ambiguous developer needs into well-defined roadmaps that deliver measurable improvements to Garner's engineering velocity
A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback
What the job involves
We are seeking an exceptional Developer Experience Engineering Manager to join our Platform team
This role will report to the VP of Platform Engineering
You will lead a specialized team dedicated to revolutionizing our internal development ecosystem by integrating cutting-edge AI capabilities into our engineering workflows, ensuring that as Garner scales, our developers remain the most productive and impactful in the industry
Lead and mentor a high-performing engineering team focused on building our AI first developer platform, ensuring individual growth aligns with our mission to accelerate technical delivery
Architect and implement AI-assisted development tools, including agentic code review, approval and agentic on-call to eliminate bottlenecks in our SDLC lifecycle
Define and track engineering adoption, velocity and quality metrics (such as DORA metrics and AI-tooling adoption rates) to provide data-driven insights needed to justify platform investment
Collaborate with product and security engineering leads to identify systemic bottlenecks and deploy automated solutions that allow our teams to focus on feature development
Own the roadmap for Developer Experience, prioritizing initiatives that pay down high-impact technical debt and modernize our CI/CD and deployment tech and associated processes
Establish standards for local development environments, ensuring every engineer at Garner has a seamless, secure, and high-leverage local development experience
Technologies we use: Claude, Go, Python, Kubernetes, Istio, Datadog, AWS, Terraform
